block.guhs.knabbelportaal.lore: A little cloud of pink cheese. Right-click: send your guhs into retirement in the Eternal Nibble Fields, or fetch them again.
gui.guhs.band.plek.in_de_knabbelvelden: Retired in the Eternal Nibble Fields. nyeg, not dead at all, just retired!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.storing: The Nibble Fields are lost for a moment (a glitch). Try again later, nyeg.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.welkom: Welcome to the Eternal Nibble Fields! Your retired guhs nibble, nap and play here. Forever. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.beschermd: No breaking or building in the Nibble Fields: everything here is just right already. nyeg!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.te_ver: You are too far from the Nibble Portal.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aangekomen: %s has arrived in the Eternal Nibble Fields. Enjoy your retirement!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.zakken_vol: Your pockets are full: %s is waiting for you at the portal.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.mee: %s is coming home with you! Put it down wherever you like. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aai.1: %s purrs like a Cheese Nibble in the sun.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aai.2: %s floats up a little, from sheer happiness.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.aai.4: %s gives you a ghost hug. Chilly, but sweet.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.vraag.uitleg: It goes into your pockets as a picked-up guh, with everything it has.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.melding.weg: %s guh(s) on their way to the Nibble Fields. Bye bye!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.melding.thuis: %s guh(s) back home! In your pockets (or at the portal).
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.melding.kwijt: A guh could not be found. Where has it gone this time?
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.niet.dood: Up in the clouds... nyeg. The Snuggleheart helps there, not the portal.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.niet.opgepakt: Picked up (an item somewhere). Put it down first.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.niet.weg: On holiday or at the office. Bring it back first.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.huisje: Lives in a Guh House. It moves out.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.guhwiel: Is running in a Guh Wheel. The wheel stops.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.guhkamer: Is staying in the Guh Room.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.bezig.rijdt: Is riding something or riding along.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.sub: Njeg, not gone for good, just retired! Pick guhs and other vadsjes and send them off or bring them back.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.leeg_thuis: You have no guhs at home. Tame one with Cheese Nibbles!
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.leeg_velde: Nobody has retired yet. It is very quiet here.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.niks_gevon: No guh found with that name.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.kies: Click a guh to see everything about it.
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.al_lang: Yours for a very long time
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.vraag.teks: These vadsjes are busy with something: %s
gui.guhs.knabbelvelden.scherm.vraag.uitl: They stop and retire (out of their house, off the Guh Wheel, out of the chest they are kept in...).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.knabbelvelden_porta: Too many guhs to take along? Build a &dNibble Portal&r (4 blocks of kaasknabbels, 4 kaasknabbels and a pink dye). Right-click it: your guhs at home on the left, &dthe Eternal Nibble Fields&r on the right. Send them into retirement or bring them back. Not dead, mind you: in the Nibble Fields they nibble, nap and float around as sweet little ghost guhs with a halo. Go and visit them with the button &dTo the Nibble Fields&r!
